description: This file contains unit tests for testing stalled connection handling in an Orleans cluster, specifically testing reconnection to gateways and silo joins under connection stall conditions.

classes.name: StallConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains tests for handling stalled connections to gateways and silos, including reconnection and silo join scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with specific options like transport type and initial silo count.

methods.name: ConnectToGwAfterStallConnectionOpened
methods.description: Tests reconnecting to the gateway after a stalled connection is opened.

methods.name: SiloJoinAfterStallConnectionOpened
methods.description: Tests adding a new silo to the cluster when the connection to the silo is stalled.

methods.name: WaitForClusterSize
methods.description: Waits until the cluster reaches the expected size by polling the management grain.
